lede: The 2026 US midterms are the whole front page today: Wikipedia's five most-read articles are all election figures or races, led by Abdul El-Sayed at 1,413,749 views, and Polymarket's board fills with Senate contests from Alaska to Mississippi. The sharpest outlier sits on Hacker News, where a report of residential proxies detected on the White House network drew 881 points, well clear of anything else on the board. Away from politics, basketball crossed the feeds, with Heat vs. Clippers topping Polymarket and turning up in search at the same time.

throughlines.title: Heat vs. Clippers
throughlines.gist: The night's one sports story to cross over, live on Polymarket's betting board and climbing Google search at the same time.
